description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible, from compute orchestration and Kubernetes to bare metal, storage, and networking.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

As a Network Product Manager on the Cloud team, you will own the strategy and roadmap for Mistral's networking product portfolio. You have a deep understanding of the rapidly evolving networking landscape, and you understand what is slowing down the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud — translating those insights into products that are flexible, easy to build on, and performant at scale.

You will work closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to build new products and enhance existing offerings, ensuring alignment with technological advancements, customer expectations, and market trends. This is a highly critical role with significant influence over the future of AI compute and networking products.

What You’ll Do

  • Product strategy: Define and execute the product vision for Mistral's networking offerings — including cluster networking, observability, VPCs, Direct Connect, cross/multi-cloud interconnects, private connectivity services, NAT, and IP address management to keep pace with the needs of AI training and inference at scale.

  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Cloud Software Engineering, and SRE to define technical specifications, execution timelines, and the performance, reliability, scalability, and cost targets the network must hit.

  • Connectivity strategy and architecture: Drive the cross-DC and multi-site connectivity strategy, network topology, and failure-domain design in close partnership with engineering.

  • Roadmap ownership: Own and prioritize the networking product roadmap, balancing customer requests, technical feasibility, and business impact.

  • Customer discovery: Build deep relationships with the infrastructure teams building on Mistral Cloud, understand their networking needs and pain points, and act as their voice inside the company.

  • Market Analysis: Research trends, opportunities, and challenges in the networking domain, and use these insights to guide product development and positioning.

  • Technical translation: Distill complex technical tradeoffs into clear, compelling narratives and decision documents for company leadership.

  • Performance monitoring: Track and analyze product performance metrics and use data-driven insights to guide product enhancements and future direction.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, hands on practitioner, with a strong focus on networking and cloud infrastructure, particularly in high-performance or AI-driven environments

  • Solid technical foundation and cloud-infrastructure knowledge. You’re comfortable reasoning about API semantics, control-plane vs data-plane behavior, system events and lifecycle, multi-tenant operational realities. You can engage with engineering teams as a peer, not as a translator. You can challenge an engineering tradeoff, not just relay one.

  • Track record of shipping technically complex platform products with measurable impact.

  • Strong analytical instincts with the ability to use data to inform and defend multi-year infrastructure decisions.

  • Ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams without direct authority, and to communicate credibly with executives, engineers, and customers.

  • Low ego, high bias for action, and comfort in ambiguity — equally at home crafting a strategy narrative and diving into metrics, a UX detail, or a customer escalation.

Bonus

  • Hands-on background in data center network design, including global backbone architectures, cross-DC and multi-site connectivity, and peering.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.
